entry_state: Reserving methods retain failed draws,process-family choices,conditioning information and reserve-centering conventions. The risk-measure discussion separates additional compensation from expected payment,derives atom-aware expected shortfall and nonnegative distortion weights,and identifies source-version formula errors with counterexamples. A new information tree now distinguishes today's variance from future conditional risk;its general inequalities continue next.
exit_state: Expected future conditional standard deviation,root expected variance and today's remaining-payment spread are different quantities. Additive revision variances require true conditional-mean reserves and do not imply independence. Capital charges retain their timing and entity choices. The reserving exchange now distinguishes valid zero payments from failed cells and preserves joint draw identity,mask and process-law provenance;its completion and stop rules continue next.
findings: The variance derivation explicitly limits its inequalities to expected future risk,with an upper-branch counterexample to a pathwise bound and no claimed quantile ordering.
The conditional-mean reserve derivation telescopes paid amounts and proves zero cross-covariances;the example still has dependent period results.
The capital formula specifies start-of-year capital and year-end charges rather than borrowing an unstated convention from a source.
The adapter example shows why zero-fill permanently loses information and why a completed-draw mean18 cannot replace the requested-sample mean. No new confirmed local defect.
